text:
nina_docs: quick thread for PR #4390 (SDK examples + migration notes). Vercel preview loads but fonts are being blocked by CSP on preview env and a hashed CSS asset 404s intermittently. Need a reviewer and a merge slot tomorrow AM. preview: https://preview-4390--redwood-docs.vercel.app :mag_right:

vercel-bot: Build completed. Route /sdk/js/ served but browser console shows CSP blocked font: "Refused to load the font 'https://...' because it violates the following Content Security Policy directive: 'font-src'." Logs: https://vercel-logs.example/4390

raul_ci: CI note: linkcheck passed but static asset check flagged one missing file: /assets/styles-9f4a2.css (404) in the preview only. Production build artifact contains it. Might be a race in the preview asset upload step.

leo_platform: have you set `site_url` or `base_url` in mkdocs.yml? Previews sometimes rewrite asset URLs when base is absolute which conflicts with the CSP in the preview runner.

nina_docs: mkdocs.yml uses `site_url: https://docs.redwood.ai` and `use_directory_urls: true`. I used an include that references `/assets/styles.css` assuming the SSG will add the hash. But the preview's HTML references the unhashed name in one include and the hashed name elsewhere, hence the 404.

raul_ci: local repro: run `mkdocs build --clean` and check `site/assets/` for hashed css file. Also run `grep -R "styles-" -n site` to find references.

nina_docs: thanks. pushed a fix to the include to use the manifest variable (we have a small plugin that exposes `assets_manifest['styles.css']`) instead of hardcoding. Triggered a redeploy.

vercel-bot: Redeploy started for preview-4390.

ci-bot: Quick reminder: preview CSP is strict and strips inline styles by default. If you need fonts in preview, add `font-src` to the preview CSP config in the infra repo or reference fonts via the same origin (relative paths).

leo_platform: redeploy looks green; I'm seeing CSS references consistent now. However, the preview still blocks Google fonts due to CSP. Two options: vendor fonts into assets and reference relatively, or request a temporary CSP relaxation on the preview runner. Which do you prefer for this release?

nina_docs: vendor into assets is safer. I'll update the example to bundle the font locally and reference `assets/fonts/Inter-Variable.woff2` in the CSS. Pushing that change now and adding a note to the PR explaining the CSP behavior for future docs authors.

vercel-bot: Deploy succeeded for preview-4390 — https://preview-4390--redwood-docs.vercel.app/sdk/js/ :white_check_mark:

leo_platform: LGTM from infra side. Quick content nit: in the JS snippet you still import `new Client({ api_key: "<API_KEY>" })` — we prefer to show the env var pattern: `const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`. Not blocking.

raul_ci: I can approve once the PR description includes the local repro steps and a short migration note about bundling fonts for previews. That helps support triage later.

nina_docs: added repro steps and a one-liner migration note. Requesting merge slot at 07:00 UTC tomorrow to align with staging deploy. Tagging reviewers: @leo_platform @raul_ci.

leo_platform: approved. I'll keep an eye on the staging deploy if you merge at 07:00.

nina_docs: thanks all — merging in the window unless anyone objects. If the staging job errors, I'll post here and we can rollback.
